decisions.title: AC domain key and topology kind
decisions.currentBehavior: AC is ordinary device_inventory; no AcDomain runtime.
decisions.problem: A logical management domain cannot be represented safely by only one ordinary device row, but AC inventory must not be duplicated.
decisions.optionA: Explicit stable AcDomain.id referencing existing device_inventory.id members; topology kind is confirmed only by member/HA/IRF/cluster evidence.
decisions.optionB: Implicitly treat every AC device as one domain and infer topology in the UI.
decisions.optionCIfNeeded: Deterministic key from sorted device IDs; membership changes require key migration.
decisions.recommendationReason: Separates logical domain lifecycle from physical device identity and keeps evidence auditable.
decisions.dataModelImpact: Future AcDomain and AcMemberDevice logical entities; no schema change in B0.
decisions.apiImpact: Future AC domain list/detail/topology endpoints; existing device inventory remains source.
decisions.securityImpact: Domain Site must derive from authorized AC Sites; no aggregate bypass.
decisions.migrationImpact: Future isolated mapping/backfill; none in B0.
decisions.uiImpact: Show domain navigation with links to source AC device IDs.
decisions.testImpact: Standalone, stack, cluster, one-plus-one, member conflict and partial domain fixtures.

decisions.title: AP serial/MAC identity precedence
decisions.currentBehavior: Parser exposes serial and MAC fields but no AP identity service exists.
decisions.problem: Missing, changing and conflicting identity evidence cannot be resolved by name, MAC suffix or first-match selection.
decisions.optionA: Use serial and complete normalized MAC set as exact evidence; missing/conflicting evidence remains candidate/conflict/unknown.
decisions.optionB: Use MAC as global primary identity.
decisions.optionCIfNeeded: Use serial as global primary identity and update MAC automatically.
decisions.recommendationReason: Supports replacement, missing fields and multi-interface evidence without silent merging.
decisions.dataModelImpact: Future PhysicalApIdentity and identity evidence/candidate/conflict projection; no B0 schema change.
decisions.apiImpact: AP resource detail must expose identity status and evidence.
decisions.securityImpact: Serial/MAC lookup must not bypass source AC Site claims.
decisions.migrationImpact: Future isolated candidate review/backfill; none in B0.

decisions.title: Multi-AC AP visibility
decisions.currentBehavior: R2 claims scope device/profile/facts, but AP resource/observation visibility does not exist.
decisions.problem: One AP observed by ACs in different Sites must not leak unauthorized observations, state or groups.
decisions.optionA: Return authorized observation subset with provenance; project AP summary only from visible observations.
decisions.optionB: Return global AP summary while hiding unauthorized AC details.
decisions.optionCIfNeeded: Hide the AP whenever any observation is unauthorized.
decisions.recommendationReason: Supports authorized operations while preventing cross-Site leakage and exposing partial scope.
decisions.dataModelImpact: Observation/binding must carry source AC, Site and relation revision.
decisions.apiImpact: All AP endpoints require observation-level Site predicates.
decisions.securityImpact: Four visibility layers: identity, observation, runtime state and group.
decisions.migrationImpact: Future relation/source Site backfill; none in B0.
decisions.uiImpact: Show scope summary and provenance only for visible facts.
decisions.testImpact: Single/multi-Site, no-authority, SUPERADMIN and cross-Site no-leak cases.

decisions.title: AP group ownership and scope
decisions.currentBehavior: Parser exposes Group text; no AP group resource/API exists.
decisions.problem: Same group names can exist under different ACs and an AP can have different group observations across ACs.
decisions.optionA: AC/domain-owned read-only observed groups with AC-scoped key; platform writes are out of scope.
decisions.optionCIfNeeded: Observed AC group plus platform local alias.
decisions.recommendationReason: Keeps current read-only evidence boundary and avoids global name joins or false device writes.
decisions.dataModelImpact: Future AC-scoped group/membership projection; no B0 schema change.
decisions.securityImpact: Group inherits source AC/domain Site claims.
decisions.migrationImpact: Future source group key/revision mapping; none in B0.
decisions.uiImpact: Group is an AC child view with source shown.
decisions.testImpact: Cross-AC duplicate names, membership changes, empty groups and denial.

decisions.title: R/M, R/B and I runtime state
decisions.currentBehavior: Parser can expose raw State; generic facts has status/source/captured/current only.
decisions.problem: Collection failure, stale data, multi-AC conflict and failover cannot be represented by latest-string-wins.
decisions.optionA: Keep raw state and normalize to master/backup/offline/unknown/stale/conflict; failed collection never becomes offline.
decisions.optionCIfNeeded: All conflicts remain unknown until manual confirmation.
decisions.recommendationReason: Maintains operational usefulness while preserving fail-closed evidence semantics.
decisions.dataModelImpact: Future observation state/freshness/confidence projection; no B0 schema change.
decisions.apiImpact: Runtime response includes raw, normalized, source, age, confidence and conflict.
decisions.migrationImpact: Future facts projection/history migration; none in B0.
decisions.uiImpact: Separate online, offline, unknown, stale, conflict and partial scope.

decisions.title: Task/report Site scope timing
decisions.currentBehavior: Task definitions/runs are single profile/command; task history is generic.
decisions.problem: Runtime reproducibility and current claim revocation must both be respected.
decisions.optionA: Freeze scope snapshot and claims revision at creation; re-check current claims on read/download/audit.
decisions.optionB: Read current claims dynamically at every stage.
decisions.optionCIfNeeded: Do not record Site scope and rely on profile role.
decisions.recommendationReason: Preserves reproducibility without allowing post-revocation reads or downloads.
decisions.dataModelImpact: Future plan/run scope snapshot and item subject; no B0 schema change.
decisions.apiImpact: Wireless plan endpoints return snapshot and current authorization state.
decisions.securityImpact: Revoked claims block result access and generic task-list bypass.
decisions.migrationImpact: Future child task/item migration; none in B0.
decisions.uiImpact: Show creation scope, current scope and revoked/partial status.
decisions.testImpact: Eight task states plus claim revocation.

decisions.title: Wireless audit provenance
decisions.currentBehavior: Existing audit is bounded and excludes credentials/raw sensitive content; wireless event vocabulary is absent.
decisions.problem: Wireless state and association decisions need traceability without putting commands or secrets into audit records.
decisions.optionA: Store action, actor, AC/AP/domain, Site claim revision, observation/relation revision, Raw manifest ID/hash and reason code only.
decisions.optionB: Include bounded raw command output in audit detail.
decisions.optionCIfNeeded: Store only success/failure without provenance references.
decisions.recommendationReason: Links audit to immutable evidence while preserving the existing no-secret/no-raw boundary.
decisions.dataModelImpact: Future wireless audit vocabulary and subject references; no B0 schema change.
decisions.apiImpact: Wireless audit query is Site/AC/AP filtered.
decisions.securityImpact: Avoids raw/credential leakage and cross-Site audit side channels.
decisions.migrationImpact: Future audit detail version/vocabulary migration; none in B0.
decisions.uiImpact: Show provenance references, operator and safe reason codes only.
decisions.testImpact: Audit visibility, no-secret leakage, cross-Site denial and hash integrity.
